on_build.initial_failure: The first attempt found C2244 because inline assembly could not choose between overloads. The native append's existing call now selects the same kernel through an explicitly typed function pointer; the repeated ON check passed.

validation.compiled_kernel: OFF object symbol for the typed overload is exactly 43 bytes: MOV EAX,ECX; MOV ECX,[ESP+4]; six sequential FLD/FSTP pairs; RET 4. The raw overload is a single FF25 indirect tail jump to that kernel; no second copy body, prologue, register changes or FP reset.

on_effect: On the wake append's short-span merge arm, use the original sequential x87 six-float load/store operation instead of C++ sample assignment. Source and destination are distinct live ring elements; the original floating-point status, NaN and exception behavior replaces the assignment's bit-copy behavior. The head/counters and all other host logic are unchanged.
off_preservation: The OFF arm contains the original sample assignment unchanged. Typed adaptation moves the existing raw leaf's instruction sequence into the typed overload; the raw entry tail-forwards with the same register/stack behavior. The native append's internal call selects the same single kernel. No game path calls the typed host adaptation when the switch is OFF.
